findings: Company-wide and Kentucky workforce totals are identical in every sampled renewal form, consistent with the form's one-Kentucky-location representation.
The reported workforce falls from 196 in 2010 to 182 in 2011, then rises to 200 by 2015 before declining to 190 in 2016.
Reported ethnic-minority employees rise from 10 in 2011-2013 to 15 by 2016.
Reported female employees range from 77 to 88 across this period.
The stated demographic collection method changes after 2010 from I-9-based sourcing to payroll plus voluntary AAP data sheets and the employee database.
controls: These are aggregate historical renewal-form values, not current workforce facts.
Do not reconstruct person-level demographic records from the aggregates.
The historical 2010 I-9 collection method is not a current approved collection rule.
